components.content:
## Important Note

When the Carbon Nitrogen ratio exceeds approximately 30, biogas production diminishes. This is an important consideration when selecting raw materials or blending feedstock for anaerobic digestion systems.

## About Biogas

Biogas is a mixture of gases produced by anaerobic (absence of oxygen) bacterial breakdown of organic matter. Biogas can be produced from raw materials such as:
- Agricultural waste
- Manure
- Municipal waste
- Plant material
- Sewage
- Green waste
- Food waste
